Edwards Roofing and Construction proudly serves homeowners and businesses throughout Central Louisiana, delivering reliable roofing and construction services with trusted local experience. Our primary service areas include:

Alexandria, Pineville, Ball, Tioga, Deville, Marksville, Jena, Colfax, Pollock, Woodworth, Glenmora, Lecompte, Boyce, and Cheneyville.

We continue to expand our reach across Central Louisiana to ensure families and property owners receive dependable service, quality workmanship, and a team they can count on. If you’re located nearby and unsure whether you’re within our service area, just reach out—our team is always happy to help.

[/et_pb_text][/et_pb_column][/et_pb_row][/et_pb_section]
